Mia (CS): quick roundup — got 3 onboarding calls today, recurring asks around: per-route billing visibility, easier embed tuning, and clearer dev setup docs. can we bucket?
Emily (Acme): +1. For us per-route billing is urgent — finance can't attribute costs. we need per-product line item or at least per-route tags.
Alex (Solutions): seeing same from two other pilots. embed tuning request = 'automatic temperature presets + examples' — users confused with defaults.
Mia (CS): noted. I captured short notes in a spreadsheet but will paste quick notes here.
Mia (CS): ```
Acme: per-route billing (urgent), example configs
Brightlane: embed-tuning presets, docs/examples
NimbleHealth: onboarding scripts, docker image size docs
``` 
Jamie (PM): thanks. can we estimate customer impact + engineering effort? need to prioritize for next quarter planning.
Emily (Acme): impact = blocking renewal for one seat renewal (small), but will expand if fixed. effort unknown.
Arun (CS Lead): proposed triage: 1) Blocking revenue/renewal 2) Broad adoption (>=3 customers) 3) Low-effort wins. apply to list.
Alex (Solutions): I'd put per-route billing = priority 1, embed presets = priority 2, docs/dockers = priority 3 (low effort).
Jamie (PM): @Mia @Arun can you each add a 1-line impact estimate and whether customer is willing to be beta tester? we'll roll into roadmap deck.
Mia (CS): will do by EOD. tagging @feedback-bot to create a ticket in Product Intake with tags: onboard, billing, embed, docs :white_check_mark:
feedback-bot: created intake ticket PROD-4521: 'Onboard feedback consolidated — per-route billing + embed presets' (link: https://redwood.prod/PROD-4521)
Emily (Acme): happy to test a beta for per-route billing once available. thanks all :pray:
Jamie (PM): perfect — I'll slot this in the weekly prioritization sync. thanks team :thumbsup:
